nom: OSEA Marine Screen SPF 50 Mineral Sunscreen

avis.texte: I have dry, medium-deep-toned skin. It leaves a faint white cast, but not the worst. It is not super hydrating. It just kind of feels like a basic mineral sunscreen.

avis.titre: Not heavy or thick on face!
avis.texte: This is great mineral sunscreen. It goes on smooth and does not feel thick or heavy on my face. I put it on in the morning under my makeup!
So nice to have a sunscreen that isn't heavy and leaving your face white It protected me perfectly on a trip to Hawaii where I was in the sun all day
This is the best. A light feeling lotion, but it totally works. I love this sunscreen. No white cast.

avis.titre: Ok, better texture than other mineral sunscreens
avis.texte: Like the texture but it seems to crystallize after some hours of use.

avis.titre: Fantastic for everyday in the sun
avis.texte: I live at the beach and need full sun coverage for my face that's not greasy and gives good coverage and lasts through the day. This checks all the boxes. No smell and it's easy to put on.

After recently buying my wife a gift of Osea products that she loved, and then reading Osea's recommendation on how to take care of my own skin, as a 73-year old male I decided on my first skincare protocol as an experiment: Ocean Cleanser, then Sea Minerals Mist, then Advanced Protection Cream, then Marine Screen SPF 50 Mineral Sunscreen. My wife so loved my "new" face, she's now using my protocol (which of course is your protocol). We're having some fun at our house with Osea these days!! Thank you for the excellent products. I'm a busy psychotherapist, and a few clients have recently entered my office and said, "let's see, am I noticing something different about you?" Pretty funny! P.S. I've had 8 MOHS surgeries on my face since 2008, so I should have been doing this a long time ago! "Better late than never."

avis.titre: Cleanest and non-greasiest I've found so far
avis.texte: I've recently revamped my entire skincare routine to clean ingredients. I needed to find something that I could wear daily under makeup and this works. Though a few ingredients are still flagged, why I took off one star, it was the best out of the choices for my intended use. I don't use it under my eyes for the reason of irritation-I found a really great one for eye protection and it doesn't irritate my skin. I use a serum under it first and wear it alone on days I'm not wearing makeup and mix it in with my foundation when I do.
Love how light and fresh it feels! You don't even know you're wearing it while protecting yourself!
The good: The color disappears into your skin very quickly. The bad: Leaves a greasy texture and pilled like crazy after my moisture (even if I waited 30 min in between) I returned.
I love this sunscreen. It's actually my first time adding sunscreen into my daily ritual and I'm very pleased

Have only used a handful of times but it absorbs beautifully, it's doesn't break me out (combo skin), it doesn't have the heavy stickiness a lot of mineral sunscreens have where if you were to touch your face your finger comes away super sticky with product.

avis.titre: Best face mineral sunscreen I've ever tried
avis.texte: This stuff is great. It has a clean smell, non greasy and non drying on my face and goes on smooth. I will be buying it again and again!
does the job but, once it has oxifized(?) on the dkin, what is the weird smell?!

So far, I'm liking the sunscreen texture; however, I notice a distinct unpleasant smell as soon as I step outdoors. At first, I thought it was air pollution, but after a couple of days, I realized it was the new sunscreen. It's honestly made me more hesitant to wear it daily, since the smell is so distractingly unpleasant when I'm in the sun.
I love this sunscreen for my face. It isn't greasy or sticky. It goes on light and does the job. My new favorite
Surprisingly lightweight and totally not greasy. This has become a daily staple.
This sunscreen has a non-greasy feel and blends well onto my skin. I'd definitely recommend it for anyone!

avis.titre: White cast if you have medium tan skin
avis.texte: I do love the texture and finish - but even after wearing it for a few hours it had a white cast. I think this would be great for lighter skin tones or underneath makeup. Would love for them to make a tinted version!
I love this sunscreen! I have very sensitive aging skin, tried so many different sunscreen, Osea is the winner
I just applied this for the first time, and I can't even tell that it is on. No white tint. Not greasy and heavy feeling like most other zinc facial sunscreens.
So excited Osea has made a sunscreen - it's very light and works well under makeup.

I was so excited when this came out and I really wanted to love it. Sadly, both my husband and I got horrible sunburns while wearing it both times. We followed the application instructions but it did not offer any protection!

I was hopeful for my first purchase but was left very disappointed. I have heard so many great things about the brand and was looking for a sunscreen for the face. I assumed because this was meant for the face, it wouldn't leave a white cast, but sadly it did. I found it to be a bit thick and hard to massage in. I don't recommend this product.
I have found the best sunscreen ever after years of using all kinds of mineral sunscreens. 100 percent the best sunscreen for me!

avis.titre: BEWARE: Product pills & doesn't layer well
avis.texte: This sunscreen is thick & moisturizing! However, it didn't layer well with other products (even after exfoliating). It clumped & pilled around my eyes, hairline, & neck. It left a white cast on my eyelids & smile lines. Not for melanated skin!
I liked how it went on smoothly without a greasy feel and it did a good job of keeping my skin from getting sunburnt.

Great SPF- I have sensitive skin and this lotion doesn't irritate my skin at all. Smooth and moisturizing without being heavy or greasy. *One drawback = My friend who has a darker skin tone than me did get a white cast that wouldn't blend in.
Goes on smooth and rubs in easily. Been wearing everyday with make up, without. Going to buy some more when this runs out.
I was very excited to see this product dropped, big fan so far! It feels great going on my skin.

I was so excited to see you had a sunscreen! We had stopped using regular screens last year and what we found wasn't horrible-wasn't great either. I love the feel of this on my face-it's not greasy! It blends very well! Finally a clean sunscreen that's amazing! My husband likes it too!

I work outside all summer, walking several miles in hot and humid conditions. This is the first facial spf that has not created white heads or painful cysts that rupture into a scab (that one was one specific brand I will not touch again). The best part is that it doesnt sting when I sweat like other mineral sunscreens! It isn't greasy or oily, feels like a light moisturizer. It is totally worth the price. Osea now lines my shelf in the bathroom. Since this camera out, every product has been replaced by Osea. And this one is 100% remaining there.

avis.titre: Finally! A face sunscreen I don't hate.
avis.texte: I typically have an issue with face sunscreens. I hate the feeling and tend to break out from them. I love this one! It leaves me glowy and not feeling thick and oily.

It would be a crime if I didn't do a review on this product. This is by far, the BEST sunscreen I've ever used. It's light, absorbs quickly and is not greasy. I highly recommend this sunscreen... THE BEST IN THE MARKET!!!!

I have been using mineral sunscreen for years but it has been difficult to find one for my face that doesn't have the white cast or pill when applying other products. Not only does this product not do that but it leaves a dewy finish. And to be SPF 50 is another bonus because I love the sun and plan to be out in it quite a lot this summer. So thank you for a product that not only looks good but provides excellent protection.

I love this company so much, but was a little disappointed when I saw how small the bottle was for the price. The scent is very mild and it goes on oily at first. Bought one for myself and one for a family member. Love the items overall that I have purchased. Wish they would expand their line. Maybe a hairspray, or candles. Always beautifully package!
I use every product you have and love them all. So I wanted to try this new screen. I liked the texture but through the day my face felt "tacky", kind of sticky.
One of the best sunscreen I've had! no white cast and so light
Great lightweight mineral sunscreen. Minimal/light fragrances. Love the product, but wish it didn't leave a white cast.

I reviewed this after having used it only a few times but now I want to update it because I have been using it as my last step in my morning skincare routine and it is amazing. It goes on so light and keep my skin so soft. I never worse any sunscreen on my face because I didn't like the way they felt on my skin..until I got this one. I'm in love with it!

Loved the feel of the marine screen! My skin felt nourished in this Florida heat. I've been wanting a clean sunscreen, so I'm thrilled OSEA has one. However, knocking off a star because it left me looking a little ashy. The white cast doesn't show much in pictures, but it's evident in person. It'll likely be my "around the house" sunscreen vs "in public" sunscreen. It pairs well with the atmosphere protection cream! I also saw the note about warming it up in hands, but it didn't make much of a difference for me.

avis.titre: If I could give this 20 stars I would!
avis.texte: I have been using OSEA for over 10 years and love their products. I have gone through many different sunscreens looking for the perfect one to add to my routine, and while I have found some I like well enough nothing has really stuck as a love. Until now. I can't even explain the perfection this sunscreen is. It's mineral, high zinc but no white caste. Goes on like actual velvet, absorbs quickly and leaves your skin so so soft. I'd like to install a constant pump in my bathroom please and thank you. You all better buy this before I buy out the entire stock!

I am honestly impressed of how good this has been working for my skin. I like that it doesn't leave any white cast. In fact it gives a nice healthy glow. Also it feel very lightweight which makes it even more enjoyable. Definitely a must have sunscreen.

avis.titre: The sunscreen we've all been dreaming of...
avis.texte: Sunscreen is something we should all be wearing on sunny or cloudy days, we know that... But, finding the right sunscreen has always been a mission until now. OSEA's marine sunscreen is not only protecting my skin from UVA/UVB rays, but it is also hydrating it! OSEA's marine sunscreen also contains hyaluronic acid, which I am a huge fan of - OSEA also carries their Hyaluronic Sea Serum (which is also a must). Having hyaluronic acid in this mineral sunscreen means that my skin is not only being protected from UVA/UVB rays, but also getting the benefits of improved elasticity and keeping fine lines at bay. I am also thankful that OSEA decided to go with an SPF of 50. I also love the packaging as it can fit in most bags for those of us that are on the go. What I love the most is knowing that by using OSEA's marine sunscreen I know that the ingredients are not only great for my skin (which is our largest organ), but that those ingredients are also clean ingredients and something I trust to put on my face throughout the day. I also have to add that unlike most sunscreens out there, this one does not leave a white residue behind - my skin just soaks it in and on some days I don't even need anything else besides OSEA's marine screen. I cannot recommend OSEA's marine sunscreen enough - try it and find out what a dream come true, mission accomplished (finally finding the right sunscreen) OSEA's marine screen is- yay!

A good sunscreen isn't easy to find. This one feels good on the skin. It applies and blends evenly and doesn't leave a white residue, which can be a challenge for me with medium toned skin. It's thick enough that I feel protected from sun exposure, especially here in Hawai`i yet lightweight enough for my skin to breathe.

avis.titre: Works well, no white cast on skin
avis.texte: For a mineral sunscreen, it's got a very lightweight feel and no white cast is left on skin. It works well, although is not waterproof or water resistant so not great if you're in hot weather where you'll be sweating.

avis.titre: Must have in your skin care routine
avis.texte: I been looking for a sunscreen that doesn't make my face oily and is perfect for my sensitive skin and this is a must have in your list of favorite Osea products.

avis.titre: Nice product, good feel on skin
avis.texte: I like this sunscreen, it goes on like a cream but feels very light; not sticky or greasy ... and no scent (which I love). I can't speak to how the SPF works because it is not yet sunny enough to test in New England. I will definitely be adding this to my skincare routine and beach bag.

I have been an Osea fan since they were offered in the "Fab Fit Fun" boxes I was gifted years ago. I love so many of their products for different reasons - my newest favorite is this SPF! Easy to apply, and goes on smoothly - no grease OR residue + is quickly absorbed. Whether I am wearing the SPF on its own (with moisturizer, of course) or adding a some light makeup - I like knowing that I am wearing protection from the sun without physically or visibly seeing it!
Fairly lightweight and smooth. I really like the product. I put it and go.

This has been such a great addition to my sunscreen regime. It is not greasy, and doesn't have the white cast that some mineral sunscreens have. It feels good on my face and doesn't just melt off. I live near the beach so I have tried many mineral sunscreens brands. The quantity in the tube is comparable to other brands, but the quality is better. I will definitely be supporting this one!

I have reactive skin and choose my sunscreen products for my face very carefully. I've tested this product on several beach days with high UV and it has worked well. While initially it appears very opaque, with just a little bit of rubbing the white cast disappears. It does have a slightly noticeable texture to the touch.

avis.titre: Possibly the best Osea Product yet!
avis.texte: I've been hoping for the day Osea made a sunscreen and it's finally here!! Ive spent a good amount of money try to find a mineral sunscreen that works for my very sensitive combination skin. I absolutely LOVE this sunscreen and would recommend it to anyone! It soaks in fast and leaves a very smoothing finish on the skin- non white casting, non greasy and a very light scent that goes away fast. The ONLY thing that would make this product better is if they had a tinted option!

avis.titre: Finally! Don't skip over this product
avis.texte: I have been waiting for OSEA to create a sunscreen like this! Its light weight doesn't clump up under my makeup and feels great on my skin when I wear only this! Love it!

avis.titre: Finally! Dont skip over this product
avis.texte: I have been waiting for OSEA to create a sunscreen like this! Its light weight doesnt clump up under my makeup and feels great on my skin when I wear only this! Love it!

Thank you so much Osea for such a wonderful product, went off shore fishing, was a beautiful sunny day, and wow, my face was protected, stayed on all day! I never even had to reapply, such a great product, so thankful to have the protection from the suns harmful rays!!

Ive tried a lot of sunscreens over the years, and this is one of the few that actually feels good to use every day. The texture is really light and smooth, it goes on easily and absorbs quickly without a heavy or greasy feeling. It layers really well under makeup, and doesnt interfere with anything I put on top. It fits great into my routine am I am already using it consistently. Ive already ordered a few more to keep in different bags because I know Ill reach for it. Definitely a new staple for me.

The great thing about this sunscreen is that it leaves no white residue on my face. I also like that it dispenses just a tiny amount, which allows me to control how much I'm squeezing out at a time, so there is less waste. There is no scent at all. I use it on my face and the backs of my hands and haven't had any problems with sensitivity. I feel protected and not greasy.

Ive been using the Marine Screen SPF 50 Mineral Sunscreen since receiving it and Im really impressed. It goes on smoothly for a mineral sunscreen and doesnt leave that heavy, chalky white cast you get with most sunscreens. My skin feels hydrated after applying it, almost like Im wearing a lightweight moisturizer instead of sunscreen. I also love that it sits well under makeup-no pilling or weird texture-and it gives my skin a nice, natural-looking glow. Knowing its made with cleaner ingredients and still provides strong SPF 50 protection is a huge plus for me. Overall, this has become a daily staple for me. Id definitely recommend it if youre looking for a mineral sunscreen that feels good on your skin and actually looks good too.
I like the product very much, it runs nice and smooth and doesnt leave my face oily afterwards, its a little to thick I would prefer it was lighter.

Im honestly impressed. Its a mineral sunscreen, but nothing like the thick, chalky ones we all remember. The texture is a hydrating emulsion-light, silky, and it just melts into the skin. No white cast at all on me, which is always a big win. It layers beautifully under makeup, almost like a primer, and gives that fresh, healthy glow without feeling heavy or greasy.
Have been using for the last couple weeks and honestly love this! Goes on so nice, no greasy feeling after using, and have had no break outs. Really love this and will continue to buy.
This sunscreen is great. Its not sticky or tacky feeling on your face. Mixes well with my foundation or worn by itself.

Have used Marine Screen in both hot, dry, poolside in Tempe, AZ and cool, humid, ocean kayaking in Laguna Beach. Both times successful in providing the absolute UV coverage I so desired. It is thick yet smooth coming out of tube but absolutely lightweight and lovely once applied. It lives up to the high expectations I know and appreciate from all OSEA products.
This SPF feels natural and lightweight on the skin. I love it.

I love this sunscreen. Its easy to apply and sinks into my skin without leaving any white marks. I used it while on holiday in San Diego. Im not a lover of sunscreen but this product is easy to use and reapply throughout the day. It didnt feel like it was thick after the second reapply and I did not get a sun burn or any redness on my face which is rare for me as I am light skinned with freckles. Its definitely my new go to sunscreen
Goes on smoothly without feeling greasy or heavy. Lightweight, absorbent.

This product is -Non-nano zinc oxide shields skin from UVA/UVB rays - Helps prevent visible sign of aging from sun exposure - Undaria seaweed softens & smooth skin - Lightweight, non-greasy hydration I love this in my daily routine

I was gifted the New Marine SPF 50 Mineral Sunscreen for review purposes. This unscented spf blends easily and I love the fact that it comes in a travel friendly tube-so convenient. If you are looking for a clean ingredient spf then this is a great one to try!
Absolutely love this sunscreen goes on easily no white cast can put makeup on top without any issues highly recommend this product
Great under makeup! Melts into skin and does not clog pores. Great size that is perfect for summer travel. Will be my go to all season long!

avis.titre: Marine Screen SPF 50 Hydrating Emulsion Mineral Sunscreen
avis.texte: The packaging of the product was amazing. Wrapped, triple wrapped, cushioned, boxed and taped. Nothing was breaking or leaking in the package! This detail may seem trivial, but its most important as the first thing you notice is if your products are damaged in any way. No damage or possibility of damage here! Pics 1 and 2. Packing: neat, clean, visually appealing. Pic 3 Opening the marine screen: nice easy to open cap, foil sealed, nicely done. Pics 4 and 5 Upon application: its a very nice lotion, creamy, smooth, not chalky in any way. First, it appears white. After virtually no effort of blending, it disappeared into my skin with zero white cast which often happens with sunscreen. No visibility of the product other than an appearance of hydration in that area. Pics 6 and 7. It simply melts into your skin, its lovely, hydrating and refreshing. There is a faint clean smell, not even describable as fragrance. Just fresh, clean, light, almost undetectable. Not overpowering, just clean.

avis.titre: Amazing!! I would buy it again
avis.texte: It is very light weight and goes well with my other skin care products. It does not form ashy white layer like other sunscreen and I tried it on both my face and body. It is not sticky. I love the product so far!

I was a bit unsure about this sunscreen because its a bit thick and white, but it goes on so smooth and is easily absorbed! Theres zero white cast and my skin feels smooth and moisturized. I wore it on my face, neck, and arms while gardening and didnt get burned. Definitely love it!
My skin is so silky after putting this on, it's not sticky at all, it sits like lotion not sunscreen. I will be buying more!

Thank you to OSEA for letting me try this ahead of the May 5 launch-I honestly love it. It goes on super smooth, no white cast, and just gives my skin a really nice glow-even when Im not wearing any makeup. It doesnt feel heavy or greasy at all (which Im picky about), and it sits really well under makeup AND no pilling or anything. Ive had zero issues with it. No irritation, no breakouts just really easy to use every day. Love it! I already use OSEA for my body and love their products, so this was an easy yes for me. Safe to say this is a new addition in my routine!!

I received this SPF complimentary in exchange for an honest review, and I was genuinely excited to try it since this was my first time participating in something like this. Ive used OSEA products before and have always been impressed-they consistently deliver on their claims, are high-quality, and have a beautiful, clean scent. I also really appreciate that their products are made with thoughtfully sourced ingredients. I often purchase their products as gifts for friends too who also absolutely love them! My honest review of the SPF: The sunscreen itself is white in color with a smooth, slightly thicker texture-not runny like some others Ive used. It does take a bit more time to fully rub in, but once applied, it feels very hydrating and leaves a healthy, dewy glow that I really enjoy. It sits nicely on the skin and layers well under makeup without pilling or feeling heavy. Interestingly, I didnt notice much of a scent at first, but I picked up a light fragrance later in the day. Overall, it performs beautifully and feels nourishing on the skin.

The sunscreen is very smooth and easy to apply. I like that a lot of product doesnt come out at once but just enough to get what you need so you arent wasting product. Its very lightweight and blends well.

I absolutely love this mineral sunscreen. I have struggled to find a mineral sunscreen where it is light enough to apply without feeling like its clogging my pores and also does not leave a white streak on my face. I really like the light weight texture and its great knowing that not only is this sunscreen protecting me from UV rays, but its also moisturizing as well.

Love this sunscreen! Ive had basil cell twice so Im very picky about what I use on my face. The marine screen dispenses easily, no scent at all, and blends nicely. Left my face with a velvet smooth finish. This will be a regular purchase for me.

I consider myself somewhat of an expert incense screen as a skin cancer survivor, I wear sunscreen every day all day I reapply it. I always have sunscreen on, so I need one thats lightweight wont clog. My pores doesnt smell bad cause I am a little picky when it comes to that. I recently tried marine screen and I am ecstatic not only from a brand I trust but a brand I love and the fact that its a three and one is incredible it moisturize your face. Its antiaging benefits, and then Son protection this is everything you want a sunscreen and more and I just absolutely love it. I love that its filled with antioxidants that are gonna protect my skin from free radicals. Its lightweight no white cast one more could a girl asked for.

This is the first physical sunscreen I've used on my skin in a long time. I usually avoid them due to the persistent white cast that is left behind, being a darker skin toner person. This however goes on and gradually fades away leaving my skin looking brighter! It works as a great base for my makeup or as mositurizer as my last step in my skincare routine. It's more on the thicker side which took sometime to get use to, but it's been a 10/10 experience using it.

Osea has done it again with their new mineral sunscreen! The new product has a great lightweight, consistency, is non-greasy, and unscented. It provides great coverage and is part of my new skincare routine. Highly recommend.

I love Osea and I also am super conscious about sun exposure, so I was excited to try this sunscreen - it goes on almost like a lotion, and doesn't feel heavy or dry. And even though it's a mineral sunscreen, there is no white cast. Love this new product:)

While this sunscreen goes on a bit thick, it settles nicely into the skin with no residue. I wore it while gardening, kayaking, and just sunbathing and it provided perfect protection for my face, which is fair and tends to burn easily. Unlike other face sunscreens I have used, this one did not cause me to breakout. I highly recommend it!

avis.titre: The BEST new addition to my skincare routine
avis.texte: I have been searching for a clean, mineral sunscreen that I actually want to wear and THIS IS IT! It is so lightweight, goes on silky-smooth, doesnt leave a white cast and works GREAT under my makeup. Ive seamlessly added it into my OSEA AM routine. I can't believe how hydrating it is, my skin thanks you! As someone who works and osea I have been waiting for this product for years and it exceeded my expectations by a long shot!

This is a solid mineral sunscreen that doesnt leave behind a white cast. The finish is perfect-it leans slightly more matte but still natural. The only issue I have is that it pills with other skincare products. Otherwise its my favorite physical sunscreen!

avis.titre: Feels nice on the skin, leaves slight white cast
avis.texte: This sunscreen feels nice on the skin - it's not sticky, not overly shiny, but is dewy enough. I have pale, olive-toned skin, and do notice a slight white cast. I don't fault this for it as that is pretty normal for a mineral sunscreen, but something to be aware of if you are giving this a try. It hasn't been too sunny yet where I live to really put this to the test, but, so far no sunburns!
Really appreciate the silky consistency and pleasant scent when applying. The other non toxic options for sunscreen are too thick and crumbly and dont spread as nicely.
Love the new marine screen! Its lightweight and goes on like facial lotion. Ive used a couple of times and it works like it says. Glad to have it for the warm days ahead.

This sunscreen is lightweight, it wears beautifully, and provides a velvety finish which leaves skin feeling bouncy, balanced and well moisturized, without any oiliness or white cast. The only issue I had was that it is difficult to initially apply, I would have loved a bit more "slip" upon application, but once applied it absorbs beautifully, so I wouldnt want to sacrifice the end reault for an easier application.
The best sunscreen Ive tried, it leaves my skin hydrate and glowing at the same time!

avis.titre: Just the sunscreen I'd expect from Osea
avis.texte: I am always hesitant about mineral sunscreen because they usually go on thick, feel heavy and have white cast. I was pleasantly surprised with this sunscreen from Osea. It goes on white, but very quickly absorbs & doesn't leave a trace. There is no smell, which is nice for daily use on my face. I was able to layer it with my tinted moisturizer and didn't feel like I had layers and layers on my face. This will come in handy for spring and summer baseball season when I'm in the sun all day cheering on my son! Thanks, Osea!
I really like this product. It is light on my skin. I have used it with and without makeup and I love it. Thank you for sharing it with me. I will definitely be using it often.
Goes on nice and smooth blends completely in. There is no greasy residue or shiny hue to skin. Love it

This is really a perfect mineral sunscreen. It goes on clear and unscented. It feels very moisturizing when you apply it and not sticky or drying at all. I don't wear facial sunscreen everyday, but I will with this one because of it's hydrating properties. I applied it over my regular moisturizer and then a light foundation over the sunscreen. It all blended perfectly. This brand never disappoints!

I LOVE all Osea products and this new sunscreen is another keeper. However, I would only recommend for your face, it is a small tube for your whole body. It does not leave a white cast, either. Non-greasy and feels great!
I am very picky when it comes to sunscreen for my face. This does go on a bit greasy but it does dry down pretty quickly. I would repurchase.

I just glove how beautiful this sunscreen sinks into my skin without leaving any sort of cast or greasy feeling behind. My skin feels moisturized, and protected, without makeup or anything sliding off throughout the day. I love it and its clean ingredients.

Im terrible at wearing sunscreen. I dont like the feeling of having a greasy film on my skin so I often skip it. This sunscreen is a game changer! Its so lightweight, moisturizing, and it absorbs very quickly so I feel like im not wearing anything at all! This will definelty be a routine staple from now on.

As someone with sensitive skin, Ive always broken out after using sunscreen but Ive used the marine screen a few times now and I am so pleased that I havent experienced any breakouts! Its light weight and doesnt sit heavy on my face. It also doesnt leave the white residue on your face like some sunscreens are prone to do! Ive also found that it is pretty hydrating and hasnt dried out my skin after use like Ive experienced in the past with out sunscreens. Really pleased with this!

This sunscreen is incredibly light weight, goes on smoothly, doesnt leave a white cast, and has an amazing smell. Ive seamlessly added it into my AM routine. Highly recommend adding to your skincare lineup!
Amazing in love with this new sunscreen, no scent, not sticky and best part for me is there is no white cast like with other mineral sunscreens.

The New Marine Screen Sunscreen feels SO good! Most importantly, it smooths all the way in, no sticky, thick sunscreen coating your skin, it has soaked right in! I love it! None of the white streaks or thick goop on the skin, just smooth, silky sun protection! Great product!

avis.titre: I'm Tossing Out All the Others!
avis.texte: I absolutely adore this new mineral sunscreen! It feels incredibly light, clean, and refreshing on my face. Unlike most sunscreens, which tend to leave my skin feeling oily, the one feels almost like a water based moisturizer. OSEA Marine sunscreen SPF 50 goes on feeling clean and light. Thank you so much for creating such an exceptional product!

avis.titre: Sunscreen that feels lime a moisturizer
avis.texte: I love the new sunscreen, it absorbs effortlessly into the skin and leaves the skin feeling bouncy and well moisturized without feeling greasy or heavily coated. The only issue I have is that the application is a little more difficult than Id like, it doesnt have quite enough slip, it a bit thick and sticky as you first apply. But I love the final finish and would not want to sacrafice this in order to have a more easily applied formulation.

I'm so happy that Osea has a sunscreen! It blends in well, doesn't have much, if any smell, doesn't leave a white cast, and is Osea, a brand where I trust the ingredients! This one is another win by Osea!

This luxury, mineral facial sunscreen is exactly what I have been looking for. It dispenses easily and is a bit on the thicker side. It glides on smoothly with an elegant texture.
